description: This Java source file defines a command handler for proposing a client transfer within the Fineract project. It implements the logic to handle transfer proposals processing, annotated as a command handler for the 'CLIENT' entity with the 'PROPOSETRANSFER' action.

classes.name: ProposeClientTransferCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles proposing a client transfer operation, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface. It uses TransferWritePlatformService to process the transfer proposal within a transactional context.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the propose transfer command and delegates to the transfer write platform service.
